task.description:
REWORK ITERATION 1 validation pass: WF-03 Step 2b for ISS-0705's REVISED Section 1 only (lib/letflow/design/iss0705-sandbox-mode-restore-fix.md). Sections 2/3/5/6 already passed a prior validation pass and are implemented/passing -- do not re-review them beyond noticing if Section 1's change broke internal consistency (e.g. §4 INV-1 wording, §7 table). On branch feature/WF03-ISS0705-20260917 (`git checkout feature/WF03-ISS0705-20260917`).

Read the revised Section 1: the fix moved from wrapping the whole test body in `SandboxAutoMode.provision!/2` (which failed in ELIXIR-DEV's Step 3 attempt with a DBConnection.OwnershipError, see handoffs/WF03-ISS0705-20260917/step-03-elixir-dev.json) to instead adding `SandboxAutoMode.enter_auto_mode!(Letflow.Repo)` as the FIRST line inside the test's own on_exit/1 cleanup callback (which is authored directly in the test, not inside a shared fixture helper). Independently verify: (1) this actually solves the timing problem -- on_exit/1 runs from ExUnit's separate OnExitHandler process, calling enter_auto_mode!/1 there sets the pool to :auto mode with no process-affinity requirement (verify against test/support/sandbox_auto_mode.ex's actual moduledoc/implementation that enter_auto_mode!/1 has no such requirement, e.g. contrast with a :manual-mode Sandbox.checkout call which WOULD need an owning process), so the subsequent DROP SCHEMA/delete_all calls in that same callback would then execute against a real :auto-mode connection with no ownership error; (2) the design still ends this test at the same :auto ambient end-state as sections 2/3 (consistency with INV-2 per CODE-DESIGNER's own note); (3) the design is unambiguous enough to implement directly, no implementation code. Claim this handoff by setting status to IN_PROGRESS only.
acceptance_criteria: Independently confirmed enter_auto_mode!/1 has no process-affinity/ownership requirement that would make it fail when called from ExUnit's OnExitHandler process, by reading the actual source
Confirmed the revised Section 1 shape would not reintroduce the original DBConnection.OwnershipError
Confirmed consistency with sections 2/3/4/7 (:auto end-state, INV wording)
Confirmed no implementation code, spec is unambiguous
next_action routes to ELIXIR-DEV to re-implement Section 1 only, on PASS
